description: Directly publish in one step to any configured social channel (including X/Threads/Bluesky/Mastodon multi-post threads, LinkedIn PDF carousels, and MP4 videos), external CMS site (one or multiple WordPress websites, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify Blog, Custom Headless Webhook via platform or targets[] with integrationId/pageName), or WordFlux Hosted Public Blog WITHOUT needing to create a draft campaign first (WordFlux automatically saves the backing campaign record behind the scenes). Also supports publishing/re-exporting an existing draft campaign in place via contentId, or saving as Draft with saveAsDraft=true. When attaching an image across channels, ALWAYS ask the user first if they want to insert the image as-is (autoFormatForPlatforms: false) or also smart-crop it for each channel optimal dimensions (autoFormatForPlatforms: true). Always share live/view links after calling and remind the user they can update or expand channels via wordflux_update_content(contentId).

authorProfileId.description: Optional Author Profile UUID for Hosted Blog attribution

autoFormatForPlatforms.description: Ask the user first: set true to smart focal-crop attached images to each channel optimal aspect ratio (e.g. 4:5/1:1 for Instagram & LinkedIn, 16:9 for Blog/CMS), or false (default) to insert the original image as-is.

cmsPublishStatus.description: Optional CMS status ("draft" or "publish"). Subject to each destination integration Agent Publish Policy (external CMS defaults to CMS Draft).

contentId.description: Optional existing draft campaign contentId to publish live (or re-export an updated WordPress/Webflow/Ghost/Shopify/Webhook/Hosted Blog post in place) without creating a duplicate campaign

createReviewLink.description: Set true to generate a shareable no-login Client Review URL (/review/:token) alongside the campaign

documentTitle.description: Optional LinkedIn PDF carousel document title

documentUrl.description: Optional HTTPS PDF URL for swipeable native LinkedIn Document Carousels (e.g. pdfUrl from wordflux_generate_carousel)

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique idempotency key so retried autonomous agent publish requests do not create duplicate posts.

linkSocialToCmsPermalink.description: Set true when publishing both a CMS/Hosted Blog article and social channels together so WordFlux publishes the article first and injects its live canonical URL (+ UTM parameters) into the social posts

mode.description: auto, publish_now (default), cms_draft (inject into external CMS as draft), draft (Wordflux library draft only), or schedule

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image files from ChatGPT to persist and attach

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

scheduledPostId.description: Optional existing scheduled post ID to publish immediately

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs (e.g. Claude Artifacts) to rasterize into PNGs

assetId.description: Optional existing assetId when scheduling or publishing a specific asset of an existing campaign (contentId)

authorProfileId.description: Optional Author Profile UUID (from wordflux_manage_content_extras action="list_authors") for Hosted Blog attribution

base64Images.description: Optional Base64 or Data URI images for this target

content.description: Platform-specific post copy or CMS/Blog article body (Markdown or semantic HTML)

documentTitle.description: Optional title for a LinkedIn PDF carousel document

documentUrl.description: Optional HTTPS PDF document URL for swipeable native LinkedIn Document Carousels (such as pdfUrl from wordflux_generate_carousel)

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment (e.g. for links or hashtags)

imageUrl.description: Optional single HTTPS image URL for this target

imageUrls.description: Optional HTTPS image URLs array for this target

integrationId.description: Optional connected integration UUID from wordflux_list_brands. Use this (or pageName) to target a specific site/account when multiple WordPress websites, Shopify stores, Webflow/Ghost sites, or social accounts are connected to the same brand, or include multiple targets[] entries with different integrationIds to send to several sites at once.

metaDescription.description: Optional SEO meta description / excerpt (150-160 chars) for WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook, or Hosted Blog

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Optional ChatGPT user-uploaded or AI-generated image file references (openaiFileIdRefs) for this target

pageId.description: Optional destination pageId (e.g. "profile" or "urn:li:organization:123" for LinkedIn, Webflow CMS collectionId, Shopify blogId, or page/location ID from wordflux_list_brands)

pageName.description: Optional human-readable page or location name

platform.description: Target platform (linkedin, instagram, threads, google-business, facebook, x, pinterest, bluesky, mastodon, youtube, tiktok, wordpress, webflow, ghost, shopify, webhook, blog, article)

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

scheduledAt.description: Optional per-target ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when staggering multiple channels across different times

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug for Hosted Blog, WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, or Webhook

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs (e.g. from Claude Artifacts) to rasterize into crisp PNGs

tags.description: Optional SEO tags or category keywords for WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook, or Hosted Blog

threadPosts.description: Optional ordered array of multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon (post 1 is published as the root post and posts 2..N are chained in order)

title.description: Optional post/article title (Pinterest, YouTube, WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook, Hosted Blog)

videoUrl.description: Optional HTTPS MP4/MOV video URL for TikTok, YouTube Shorts/Videos, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn Video, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, or Mastodon

wordpressCategoryIds.description: Optional WordPress category IDs array (from wordflux_manage_integrations action="get_wp_categories")

threadPosts.description: Optional ordered array of multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon

userConfirmedLivePublish.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview and destination to the user and receiving explicit confirmation in chat to publish live (required for Social/Hosted Blog channels set to Confirm in Chat).

videoUrl.description: Optional HTTPS MP4/MOV video URL for TikTok, YouTube, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, or Mastodon

name: wordflux_publish_now
